references.text: The parallel account of when Israel sent messengers to Sihon, king of the Amorites, asking for permission to pass through his land.
Moses' retelling of the event where Israel sent messengers to King Sihon in Heshbon with a peaceful request for passage.
A similar situation where Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom requesting permission to pass through his land, promising to stay on the main road.
Describes how Sihon, king of Heshbon, refused to let Israel pass through his land.
The continuation of the account where Sihon denied Israel passage and gathered his army against them.
